info.name: Reggae & Dub
info.description: One drop, dancehall, organ bubble and a dub reggae song.

songs.name: Dub Reggae
songs.description: A dub reggae song in A minor at 72 BPM, all synth sounds: intro, riddim, dub, drop, riddim, dub and outro on the four Dub Reggae patterns. The dubs are the riddim taken apart by the automation: instruments muted and brought back, echo throws on the snare and the skank, a siren panned across the stereo and transposed, a pad that swells in; the drop opens a resonant filter on a saturated bass, the melodica's tape echo runs away before a drum solo, and the outro fades and crushes the siren.

patterns.name: Dembow
patterns.description: Dancehall dembow, 1 measure: kick on every beat, snare in a 3-3-2 figure (1, 1a, 2&, 3, 3a, 4&), 16th closed hats, open hat on each &.

patterns.name: Reggae One Drop
patterns.description: Reggae one drop, 1 measure: kick and cross-stick together on 3 only, nothing on 1, swung 8th hats accented on the &, open hat on 4& every 4 passes; snare fill on 4e, 4& and 4a every 8.

patterns.name: Reggae Organ Bubble
patterns.description: Reggae one drop with a percussive organ, 1 measure: A minor skank on every off-beat 8th and soft single notes on the beats (the bubble) walking A, C, A, E.

patterns.name: Reggae Sub Bass
patterns.description: Reggae one drop with a sub bass, 1 measure: A minor line walking down (A, C, D, E) in long round notes with space left on 1, one short echo on 2a; the drums stay on the one drop.

patterns.name: Reggae Dub
patterns.description: Reggae dub, 4 measures on the one drop: kick and cross-stick on 3, a sub bass in A minor that leaves 1 empty and drops out halfway through measure 4, an organ skank on the off-beats sent a little to the echo, and one snare thrown into the echo and the reverb on 4& of measure 4, whose repeats ring over the next 1. Uses the shared echo and reverb (Echo page): their time and feedback are set there.

patterns.name: Dub Reggae Intro
patterns.description: Intro of the Dub Reggae demo, 4 measures in A minor at 72 BPM: a dub siren and a pad over a lone rimshot, then the one-drop, the sub bass and the skank come in, and a tom fill.

patterns.name: Dub Reggae Riddim
patterns.description: The riddim of the Dub Reggae demo, 4 measures in A minor (Am Am Dm Em) at 72 BPM: one-drop synth drums, a sub bass, a skank on the off-beats, an organ bubble and a melodica line in tape echo. The pad and the siren are muted: the song's automation brings them in.

patterns.name: Dub Reggae Drop
patterns.description: The drop of the Dub Reggae demo, 4 measures: steppers kick on every beat, 16th hats, a heavier bass line and lone skank stabs left to the echo, and the siren on the last measure.

patterns.name: Dub Reggae Outro
patterns.description: Outro of the Dub Reggae demo, 4 measures: the riddim for two measures, then the bass stops, the skank and a last rimshot ring out in the echo, and the siren and the pad fade.
